name: TimePicker
description: Native time field with an HH:MM contract and an optional clear button.
designIntent: Like DatePicker: the platform time control is already accessible and locale-aware. TimePicker standardizes the HH:MM contract and clear affordance.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fired with the time string; '' when cleared.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button once a value exists.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the clear button.

antiPatterns.title: Don't mix 12h display with 24h state
antiPatterns.explanation: State stays HH:MM; format for display with Intl.

accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a label describing the moment

guidelines: Describe the moment (Starts at / Ends by)
